drafts.body:
Hi Tauhid,

Thanks for reaching out about the Classic Bulldog Tee in size S. Size S is currently unavailable. It is expected to be restocked on September 5, 2026; this is an expected date, not a promise of earlier delivery.

If you prefer, sizes M, L, and XL are available now. Let us know which option works best for you.

Thank you,
Campus Customs
